subtitle: Lesson 40 · Parallelism & Configuration Tuning

code:
EXEC sp_configure 'max server memory', 24576; -- MB
RECONFIGURE;

Default (unlimited) lets the buffer pool grow
until it starves the OS and other processes —
a common cause of "it was fine yesterday."
caption: Deliberate sizing, with headroom for the OS and other components.
Meaningfully reduces plan cache bloat, without hurting queries that repeat.
